<!-- README.md is generated from .setup/readme/README.Rmd, which rProject's
docker template writes. Edit .setup/readme/description.md, scripts/cran.txt,
scripts/github.txt, or .setup/scripts/project.R instead. -->

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>",
  echo = FALSE,
  results = "asis"
)
Read <- function(file) {
  if (!file.exists(file)) {
    return(character(length = 0))
  }
  x <- readLines(con = file, warn = FALSE)
  trimws(x = x[!grepl(pattern = "^[[:space:]]*(#|$)", x = x)])
}
# the public repository (owner/repository) names the image: locally from
# .setup/repo/public-github.md (private), in GitHub Actions (Make Project
# renders the README in the public repository) from GITHUB_REPOSITORY;
# without either the README would read NA/NA, so stop
public <- Read(file.path(".setup", "repo", "public-github.md"))[1]
if (is.na(x = public) || !nzchar(x = public)) {
  public <- Sys.getenv(x = "GITHUB_REPOSITORY")
}
if (!grepl(pattern = "^[^/]+/[^/]+$", x = public)) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "\n\nNo public repository (.setup/repo/public-github.md or",
      " GITHUB_REPOSITORY): the README cannot name the image.\n\n"
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}
owner <- sub(pattern = "/.*$", replacement = "", x = public)
repo <- sub(pattern = "^.*/", replacement = "", x = public)
image <- paste0(
  owner,
  "/",
  sub(pattern = "^docker-", replacement = "", x = repo)
)
from <- sub(
  pattern = "^FROM[[:space:]]+",
  replacement = "",
  x = grep(
    pattern = "^FROM",
    x = readLines(con = "Dockerfile"),
    value = TRUE
  )[1]
)
files <- sort(
  x = list.files(
    path = file.path(".github", "workflows"),
    pattern = "\\.ya?ml$"
  )
)
text <- lapply(
  X = file.path(".github", "workflows", files),
  FUN = readLines,
  warn = FALSE
)
titles <- vapply(
  X = text,
  FUN = function(x) {
    line <- grep(pattern = "^name:", x = x, value = TRUE)[1]
    trimws(x = sub(pattern = "^name:", replacement = "", x = line))
  },
  FUN.VALUE = character(length = 1)
)
Triggers <- function(x) {
  out <- character(length = 0)
  cron <- sub(
    pattern = "^.*cron:[[:space:]]*\"?([^\"]*)\"?.*$",
    replacement = "\\1",
    x = grep(pattern = "cron:", x = x, value = TRUE)
  )
  if (length(x = cron) > 0L) {
    part <- strsplit(x = cron[1], split = " ", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    out <- c(
      out,
      sprintf(
        fmt = "daily at %02d:%02d UTC",
        as.integer(x = part[2]),
        as.integer(x = part[1])
      )
    )
  }
  if (any(grepl(pattern = "^  workflow_run:", x = x))) {
    out <- c(out, "after Make Project")
  }
  if (any(grepl(pattern = "^  push:", x = x))) {
    out <- c(out, "on push")
  }
  if (any(grepl(pattern = "base-image-built", x = x))) {
    out <- c(out, "when the base image is rebuilt")
  }
  ifelse(
    test = length(x = out) > 0L,
    yes = paste(out, collapse = ", "),
    no = "by hand"
  )
}
arm64 <- any(
  vapply(
    X = text,
    FUN = function(x) {
      any(grepl(pattern = "linux/arm64", x = x, fixed = TRUE))
    },
    FUN.VALUE = logical(length = 1)
  )
)
packages <- Read(file.path("scripts", "cran.txt"))
cran <- if (file.exists(file.path("scripts", "cran.txt"))) {
  readLines(con = file.path("scripts", "cran.txt"), warn = FALSE)
} else {
  character(length = 0)
}
github <- Read(file.path("scripts", "github.txt"))
description <- file.path(".setup", "readme", "description.md")
```

# `r image`

```{r}
cat(
  "<!-- badges: start -->",
  paste0(
    "[![", titles, "](https://github.com/", public, "/actions/workflows/",
    files, "/badge.svg)](https://github.com/", public, "/actions/workflows/",
    files, ")"
  ),
  "<!-- badges: end -->",
  sep = "\n"
)
```

## Description

```{r}
if (file.exists(description)) {
  cat(readLines(con = description, warn = FALSE), sep = "\n")
  cat("\n")
}
cat(
  "\nBased on `", from, "`; built for ",
  ifelse(test = arm64, yes = "linux/amd64 and linux/arm64", no = "linux/amd64"),
  ". Source: <https://github.com/", public, ">.\n",
  sep = ""
)
```

## Use

```{r}
# RStudio Server: the image publishes port 8787 or installs it
dockerfile <- readLines(con = "Dockerfile", warn = FALSE)
rstudio <- any(
  grepl(pattern = "EXPOSE[[:space:]]+8787|install_rstudio", x = dockerfile)
)
if (rstudio) {
  user <- sub(
    pattern = "^.*DEFAULT_USER=\"?([^\" ]+)\"?.*$",
    replacement = "\\1",
    x = grep(pattern = "DEFAULT_USER=", x = dockerfile, value = TRUE)[1]
  )
  if (is.na(x = user)) {
    user <- "rstudio"
  }
  cat(
    "RStudio Server (Docker):\n\n",
    "```bash\n",
    "docker run --rm -ti -e PASSWORD=yourpassword",
    " -p 127.0.0.1:8787:8787 ", image, "\n",
    "```\n\n",
    "Open `http://localhost:8787` in a web browser to launch",
    " RStudio Server (`127.0.0.1` keeps it on this computer).\n\n",
    "- username: ", user, "\n",
    "- password: yourpassword\n\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}
cat(
  "Docker (Docker Hub or the GitHub Container Registry):\n\n",
  "```bash\n",
  "docker run -it ", image, "\n",
  "docker run -it ghcr.io/", image, "\n",
  "```\n\n",
  "Apptainer:\n\n",
  "```bash\n",
  "apptainer pull ",
  sub(pattern = "^.*/", replacement = "", x = image),
  ".sif docker://",
  image,
  "\n",
  "apptainer shell ",
  sub(pattern = "^.*/", replacement = "", x = image),
  ".sif\n",
  "```\n",
  sep = ""
)
```

```{r}
if (length(x = packages) > 0L || length(x = github) > 0L) {
  cat("## Contents\n\n")
}
if (length(x = packages) > 0L) {
  cat("R packages from CRAN (`scripts/cran.txt`), with their dependencies:\n\n")
  # the file's header (the comments before the first blank line) is no
  # group; a comment after it names the group of the lines below it
  lines <- trimws(x = cran)
  blank <- which(x = !nzchar(x = lines))
  if (
    length(x = blank) > 0L &&
      all(
        grepl(
          pattern = "^#",
          x = lines[seq_len(length.out = blank[1] - 1L)]
        )
      )
  ) {
    lines <- lines[-seq_len(length.out = blank[1])]
  }
  group <- "Other"
  groups <- list()
  for (line in lines) {
    if (!nzchar(x = line)) {
      next
    }
    if (grepl(pattern = "^#", x = line)) {
      group <- trimws(x = sub(pattern = "^#+", replacement = "", x = line))
      next
    }
    groups[[group]] <- c(groups[[group]], line)
  }
  groups <- groups[lengths(x = groups) > 0L]
  if (identical(x = names(x = groups), y = "Other")) {
    cat(paste(groups[["Other"]], collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")
  } else {
    for (g in names(x = groups)) {
      cat("- ", g, ": ", paste(groups[[g]], collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")
    }
  }
  cat("\n")
}
if (length(x = github) > 0L) {
  cat(
    "R packages from GitHub (`scripts/github.txt`), installed after CRAN:\n\n"
  )
  cat(
    paste0(
      "- [",
      sub(pattern = "@.*$", replacement = "", x = github),
      "](https://github.com/",
      sub(pattern = "@.*$", replacement = "", x = github), ")"
    ),
    sep = "\n"
  )
  cat("\n")
}
```

## Builds

```{r}
cat(
  paste0(
    "- ", titles, " (`", files, "`): ",
    vapply(X = text, FUN = Triggers, FUN.VALUE = character(length = 1))
  ),
  sep = "\n"
)
cat(
  "\nThe images are pushed to Docker Hub and the GitHub Container Registry ",
  "as `",
  image, ":latest`.\n",
  sep = ""
)
```
